transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hello. I'm here because I spend so much time checking and rechecking how I look at the gym and before going out that it’s taking over my days. It has gotten to the point where I just really need some help with it.

When you worry about how you look, do you mainly fear that other people will judge or notice a flaw, or do you feel convinced there is actually something wrong with your appearance even when others say it looks fine?

I am completely convinced that there is actually something wrong with my face, specifically that it looks crooked and my jawline is weird from the side, even though my friends insist they don't see anything. I feel like I constantly have to hide this messed-up side of my face because I just can't let anyone see me looking like that.

Do you ever recognize that your concern about your face might be exaggerated or not really true, or are you certain it is definitely abnormal? Has this belief ever felt so strong that nothing anyone says can make you doubt it at all?

I'm not really sure how to answer that, and I haven't really thought about it in those terms. I just know that when I look in the mirror, it looks completely wrong to me and it's hard to think about anything else.

At times, can you consider that your face might actually look normal and that your mind may be exaggerating it, or are you completely certain it is abnormal no matter what anyone says? Has this belief ever felt impossible to question?

It's really hard to say, but to me, it just feels so real that it's incredibly difficult to doubt. When I look at myself, the flaws seem so obvious that it's hard to believe my mind is just playing tricks on me.

When someone you trust tells you your face looks normal, are you ever able to think they might be right, even for a moment? Or do you feel completely certain your face is abnormal no matter what anyone says?

Honestly, I find it completely impossible to believe them when they say they don't see anything wrong. I am totally convinced my face looks crooked and my jawline is weird from the side, and I'll spend hours zooming in and picking apart photos because it just looks wrong to me no matter what anyone says.
